scripts.build: pnpm --dir backend run build && pnpm --dir frontend run build
scripts.format: pnpm --dir backend run format && pnpm --dir frontend run format
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir backend run lint && pnpm --dir frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir backend run typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --dir backend run test && pnpm --dir frontend run test
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:architecture && pnpm --dir frontend run verify
scripts.verify:production: pnpm --dir backend run verify:production && pnpm --dir frontend run verify:production
